# Paper5

> Paper5 is the connected project workspace for small teams and startups to plan sprints, track tasks and deadlines, run meetings, and sync development workflows across GitHub and Discord.

## Core Pages

- [Paper5 Homepage](https://paper5.co/): Official marketing landing page and product overview.
- [Features](https://paper5.co/features): Detailed walkthrough of sprint tracking, proof of work, and real-time notifications.
- [Integrations](https://paper5.co/product-integrations): Overview of GitHub, Discord, Resend, and API integrations.
- [Documentation](https://paper5.co/docs): User guides and workspace setup documentation.
- [API Reference](https://paper5.co/docs/api): Public API endpoints and developer reference.
- [About](https://paper5.co/about): Company overview and mission.
- [Security](https://paper5.co/security): Security architecture, RLS policies, and data protection standards.
- [Changelog](https://paper5.co/changelog): Latest product updates and feature releases.
- [Contact](https://paper5.co/contact): Sales, support, and general inquiries.
